_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTIO: The APaginationPages component renders page navigation only. It emits update:offset so the parent can load the next slice of items while keeping the current page in sync.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_PROPS_TOTAL_COUNT_DE: Total number of items in the data set. Used to calculate the number of pages and the button range.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_PROPS_DISABLED_DESCR: Disables page buttons and navigation controls.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_PROPS_LIMIT_DESCRIPT: Number of items per page. Together with offset it defines the current page.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_PROPS_MAX_PAGES_DESC: Maximum amount of page buttons that may be shown at once.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_PROPS_MODE_DESCRIPTI: Mode: normal, short, loadMore, infinite. loadMore shows the button "Load more", infinite loads also by scrolling.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_PROPS_OFFSET_DESCRIP: Offset of the first row. An offset behind the last page shows the last page. Not needed with v-model:page.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_PROPS_TEXTS_DESCRIPT: Object with translation keys or text labels used by the pager.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_GROUP_MAX_PAGES_DESC: Use the slider to change max-pages and see how the button range is trimmed.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_GROUP_DISABLED_DESCR: Toggle disabled to block all page navigation.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_GROUP_MODE_DESCRIPTI: Choose between the short, normal and loadMore layouts. loadMore shows a button that adds the next rows (event update:limit) and a status with the count of the shown rows, read by the screen reader after every click.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_ACCESSIBILITY_: Accessibility: the pages are native buttons in a nav with a name. The current page has aria-current="page" and stays focusable, the disabled buttons have the attribute disabled. When the focused button becomes disabled (e.g. "next" on the last page), the focus goes to the current page. "…" is hidden for the screen reader. In right-to-left the arrows are mirrored.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_GROUP_EDGES_DESCRIPT: With show-edges the first and the last page are always shown, a gap is shown as "…": 1 … 8 9 10 11 12 … 30.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_GROUP_JUMPER_DESCRIP: show-jumper shows a field to go to a page. Only whole numbers from 1 to the last page are accepted, otherwise an error is announced and the focus stays in the field.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_GROUP_PAGE_DESCRIPTI: Instead of offset the page can be bound with v-model:page. The event change gets { page, offset, limit } after every change of the page.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_GROUP_HIDE_DESCRIPTI: With hide-on-single-page the navigation is not shown when all rows fit on one page.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_GROUP_INFINITE_DESCR: The mode infinite loads the next rows when the button "Load more" comes near the view (IntersectionObserver). The button stays for the keyboard and the screen reader, the status with the count of the shown rows is announced.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_GROUP_SLOTS_DESCRIPT: The slots first, previous, next, last replace the icon of the arrow, the slot page the number. The content of the slots is only visual (aria-hidden), the screen reader reads the texts of the prop texts.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_PROPS_HIDE_ON_SINGLE: Hides the navigation when there is only one page.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_PROPS_ICONS_DESCRIPT: Icon of the arrow button: a name of AIconPlugin or an SVG. In right-to-left it is mirrored.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_PROPS_ID_DESCRIPTION: Id of the navigation, the field of show-jumper uses it as prefix.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_PROPS_PAGE_DESCRIPTI: Current page (from 1) for v-model:page. If it is set, it is used instead of offset.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_PROPS_SHOW_EDGES_DES: Always shows the first and the last page, a gap as "…".
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_PROPS_SHOW_JUMPER_DE: Shows a field to go to a page.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_EVENTS_CHANGE_DESCRI: After a change of the page: { page, offset, limit }.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_EVENTS_UPDATE_LIMIT_: Modes loadMore and infinite: the new limit (more rows) and { loadMore: true }.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_SLOTS_ARROWS_DESCRIP: Content of the arrow button instead of the icon (only visual). Props: { disabled }.
_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_SLOTS_PAGE_DESCRIPTI: Content of a page button instead of the number (only visual). Props: { page, isActive }.
